Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block

Class StackRun<BE extends StackBlockEntity>

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StackRun<BE>
All Implemented Interfaces:
StackRunItemAccess
Direct Known Subclasses:
BarColumn, SinglesColumn, StoragePile
public abstract class StackRun<BE extends StackBlockEntity> extends Object implements StackRunItemAccess
Mechanics shared by every maximal vertical run of one stack type. Concrete runs retain their distinct insertion, extraction, growth, settlement, and collapse rules.
